Questions 1–10

Complete the notes below.

Write ONE WORD AND/OR A NUMBER for each answer.

Create a cover for an so they can drop it from a height without breaking it.
Take part in a competition to build the tallest

Activities:
Build model cars, trucks and and learn how to program them so they can move

transcript.en: Hello. Children's Engineering Workshops.
transcript.zh: 你好。儿童工程工作室。

transcript.en: Oh hello. I wanted some information about the workshops in the school holidays.
transcript.zh: 哦，你好。我想了解一些关于学校假期的研讨会信息。

transcript.en: Sure.
transcript.zh: 当然。

transcript.en: I have two daughters who are interested. The younger one's Lydia, she's four - do you take children as young as that?
transcript.zh: 我有两个女儿感兴趣。小女儿叫莉迪亚，今年四岁 - 你们接受这么小的孩子吗？

transcript.en: Yes, our Tiny Engineers workshop is for four to five-year-olds.
transcript.zh: 是的，我们的 "小小工程师 "工作坊是为四到五岁的孩子准备的。

transcript.en: What sorts of activities do they do?
transcript.zh: 他们会做哪些活动？

transcript.en: All sorts. For example, they work together to design a special cover that goes round an egg, so that when it's inside they can drop it from a height and it doesn't break. Well, sometimes it does break but that's part of the fun!
transcript.zh: 各种各样的。例如，他们一起设计了一个特殊的套子，可以套在鸡蛋上。这样，当鸡蛋在里面时，他们可以从高处掉下来，而鸡蛋不会碎。好吧，有时它确实会碎，但这也是乐趣的一部分！

transcript.en: Right. And Lydia loves building things. Is there any opportunity for her to do that?
transcript.zh: 对。莉迪亚也喜欢建造东西。有什么机会让她做这个吗？

transcript.en: Well, they have a competition to see who can make the highest tower.You'd be amazed how high they can go.
transcript.zh: 嗯，他们有一个比赛，看谁能造出最高的塔。你会惊讶于他们能做多高。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 很好。

transcript.en: But they're learning all the time as well as having fun.
transcript.zh: 他们一直在学习，同时也在享受乐趣。

transcript.en: For example, one thing they do is to design and build a car that's attached to a balloon,and the force of the air in that actually powers the car and makes it move along.
transcript.zh: 例如，其中一个活动是设计和建造一辆连接在气球上的汽车，空气的力量实际上为汽车提供了动力，使它向前移动。

transcript.en: They go really fast too.
transcript.zh: 他们的速度也非常快。

transcript.en: OK, well, all this sounds perfect.
transcript.zh: 好吧，这一切听起来很完美。

transcript.en: Now Carly, that's my older daughter, has just had her seventh birthday,so presumably she'd be in a different group?
transcript.zh: 现在来说说卡莉，也就是我的大女儿，刚刚过完她的七岁生日，所以她应该是在一个不同的小组里吧？

transcript.en: Yes, she'd be in the Junior Engineers. That's for children from six to eight.
transcript.zh: 是的，她会在初级工程师组。那是为六到八岁的孩子准备的。

transcript.en: And do they do the same sorts of activities?
transcript.zh: 他们做同样的活动吗？

transcript.en: Some are the same, but a bit more advanced.  So they work out how to build model vehicles, things like cars and trucks, but also how to construct animals using the same sorts of material and technique,and then they learn how they can program them and make them move.
transcript.zh: 有些是一样的，但要更高级一些。他们研究如何建造车辆模型，比如汽车和卡车，也研究如何用同样的材料和技术建造动物，然后他们学习如何给它们编程，让它们移动。

transcript.en: So they learn a bit of coding?
transcript.zh: 所以他们学会了一些编程？

transcript.en: They do. They pick it up really quickly.
transcript.zh: 是的。他们很快就能学会。

transcript.en: We're there to help if they need it, but they learn from one another too.
transcript.zh: 如果他们需要，我们会在那里提供帮助，但他们也会互相学习。

transcript.en: Right. And do they have competitions too?
transcript.zh: 真好。那他们也有比赛吗？

transcript.en: Yes, with the Junior Engineers, it's to use recycled materials like card and wood to build a bridge, and the longest one gets a prize.
transcript.zh: 是的，初级工程师的比赛是用回收的材料，如卡片和木头，来建造一座桥，最长的桥可以得到奖励。

transcript.en: That sounds fun. I wouldn't mind doing that myself!
transcript.zh: 这听起来很有趣。我不介意自己做这个 !

transcript.en: Then they have something a bit different, which is to think up an idea for a five-minute movie and then film it,using special animation software.
transcript.zh: 然后他们有一些不同的东西，那就是想出一个五分钟的电影的想法，然后用特殊的动画软件把它拍下来。

transcript.en: You'd be amazed what they come up with.
transcript.zh: 你会惊讶于他们想出来的东西。

transcript.en: And of course, that's something they can put on their phone and take home to show all their friends.
transcript.zh: 当然，这也是他们可以放在手机里，带回家给所有的朋友看的东西。

transcript.en: Exactly, And then they also build a robot in the shape of a human,and they decorate it and program it so that it can move its arms and legs.
transcript.zh: 没错。然后，他们还会建造了一个人类形状的机器人，他们对其进行装饰，并对其进行编程，使其能够移动手臂和腿。

transcript.en: Perfect. So, is it the same price as the Tiny Engineers?
transcript.zh: 完美。那么，它的价格和 "小工程师 "一样吗？

transcript.en: It's just a bit more: £50 for the five weeks.
transcript.zh: 只是多一点。五个星期是50英镑。

transcript.en: And are the classes on a Monday, too?
transcript.zh: 那么课程也是在星期一吗？

transcript.en: They used to be, but we found it didn't give our staff enough time to clear up after the first workshop,so we moved them to Wednesdays.
transcript.zh: 以前是的，但我们发现这样做没有给我们的员工足够的时间在第一次研讨会后进行清理，所以我们把它移到了星期三。

transcript.en: The classes are held in the morning from ten to eleven.
transcript.zh: 这些课程是在上午十点到十一点举行的。

transcript.en: OK. That's better for me actually.
transcript.zh: 好的，这对我来说其实更好。

transcript.en: And what about the location? Where exactly are the workshops held?
transcript.zh: 那地点呢？研讨会到底是在哪里举行的？

transcript.en: They're in building 10A - there's a big sign on the door,you can't miss it, and that's in Fradstone Industrial Estate.
transcript.zh: 他们在10A楼--门上有一个大牌子，你不可能错过它，那是在弗拉德斯通工业区。

transcript.en: Sorry?
transcript.zh: 什么？

transcript.en: Fradstone - that's F-R-A-D-S-T-O-N-E.
transcript.zh: 弗拉德斯通--就是F-R-A-D-S-T-O-N-E。

transcript.en: And that's in Grasford, isn't it?
transcript.zh: 那是在Grasford，对吗？

transcript.en: Yes, up past the station.
transcript.zh: 是的，在车站的前面。

transcript.en: And will I have any parking problems there?
transcript.zh: 在那里会有任何停车问题吗？

transcript.en: No, there's always plenty available. So would you like to enrol Lydia and Carly now?
transcript.zh: 不会，那里总是有很多停车位。那么，你现在想为莉迪亚和卡莉报名吗？

transcript.en: OK.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: So can I have your full name ...
transcript.zh: 那么我可以知道你的全名吗...？
